posting_text:
Nimbus Analytics Private Limited is hiring a Junior Data Analyst for our Chennai office (Guindy, Tamil Nadu).

About the role:
You will work with the reporting team to build SQL models, maintain dashboards and support monthly business reviews for our retail clients.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field
- Working knowledge of SQL and Python (pandas)
- 0-2 years of experience; final-year students may apply

Compensation: Rs 4,50,000 per annum plus standard benefits (PF, health insurance).

Selection process:
1. Online SQL assessment (45 minutes)
2. Technical interview with the analytics team
3. Discussion with the hiring manager
4. Written offer, followed by background verification

Apply through our careers page at https://www.nimbusanalytics.in/careers or write to careers@nimbusanalytics.in. We never charge candidates any fee at any stage of hiring.
